name: Phylactery of the Cloaked Mantle
effect: Grants a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against divinations and mind-affecting effects. Wearer leaves no psychic imprint.

name: Phylactery of Undead Turning
effect: Increases effective cleric or paladin level by +4 for turning checks and turn damage.

name: Pipes of Haunting
effect: Twice per day, playing these bone pipes forces all hearing creatures within 30 ft to make a DC 13 Will save or become frightened for 4 rounds.

name: Pipes of Pain
effect: A haunting melody that causes all creatures within 30 ft who hear it to suffer 1d4 points of sonic damage each round and a -4 penalty on attack rolls and skill checks (DC 14 Fortitude negates).

name: Pipes of Sounding
effect: Playing these silver pipes allows the performer to generate ghost sound illusions anywhere within 60 ft at will.

name: Pipes of the Sewers
effect: Playing these wooden pan pipes summons 1d3 swarms of dire rats (Perform check DC 10) that obey the piper as long as the music continues.

name: Plate Armor of the Deep
effect: +1 full plate (+9 AC, max Dex +1, ACP -6). Allows the wearer to breathe underwater, move without water penalties, and communicate with water-breathing creatures.

name: Plate of the Righteous
effect: Relic of Heironeous. +3 holy full plate (+11 AC, max Dex +1, ACP -6). Grants damage reduction 5/evil and +2 sacred bonus on all melee attack rolls.

name: Portable Bridge
effect: 1/day on command, unfolds into a solid wooden and iron bridge up to 30 feet long and 5 feet wide, supporting up to 5,000 pounds.

name: Portable Hole
effect: Opens a 6-foot diameter extradimensional circular hole 10 feet deep (volume 282 cu ft). Folds into pocket handkerchief.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Anchor)
effect: A single-use magical feather. When touched to a boat or ship, anchors it firmly in place for 1 full day regardless of storms or tides.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Bird)
effect: A single-use magical feather that transforms into a small bird capable of delivering a written message across any distance on the same plane to a designated recipient.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Fan)
effect: A single-use feather that produces a sustained flapping breeze strong enough to propel a sailing ship at 4 times normal speed for 8 hours.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Swan Boat)
effect: A single-use feather that instantly forms a wooden swan boat capable of carrying 32 Medium creatures across water at 24 mph for 1 full day.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Tree)
effect: A single-use feather. Planted in soil, instantly springs into an enormous 60-foot oak tree with a 5-foot-diameter trunk and full canopy in 1 round.

name: Quaal's Feather Token (Whip)
effect: A single-use feather that transforms into an animated dancing force whip that attacks designated foes as a +1 whip (+10 attack, 1d6+1 damage) for 1 hour.

name: Quarterstaff of the Alchemist
effect: A +2/+2 spell storing quarterstaff (1d6/1d6, crit x2). The hollow ends contain chambers holding alchemical items (alchemist's fire, acid) that coat strikes on command as a free action.

name: Quicksilver Boots
effect: 2/day as a swift action, move up to your land speed without provoking attacks of opportunity and enter or cross water as if solid ground.

name: Quiver of Ehlonna
effect: Three extradimensional compartments store up to 60 arrows, 18 javelins, and 6 bows/spears. Weight is always 2 lbs.

name: Quiver of Lies
effect: Extradimensional quiver holding up to 60 arrows. Nonmagical arrows drawn from it become invisible while in flight, denying targets their Dexterity bonus to AC against the shot.

name: Raiment of the Four
effect: Part of the Raiment of the Four set. Allows wearer to expend a prepared spell or spell slot to cast magic missile, fireball, teleport, or freedom of movement (depending on piece synergy).

name: Rapier of the Exalted
effect: Relic of Ehlonna. A +3 holy rapier (1d6, 18-20/x2). Deals +2d6 damage against evil creatures. Wielder gains continuous protection from evil and wild empathy as a 10th-level ranger.

name: Rapier of Unerring Direction
effect: A +2 seeking rapier (1d6, 18-20/x2). Completely negates all miss chances from concealment and grants a +5 bonus on Survival checks to avoid becoming lost.

name: Raptor's Mask
effect: Grants a +5 competence bonus on Spot checks and immunity to being blinded or dazzled by light effects.

name: Recaster's Armbands
effect: 3/day as a swift action, change the energy descriptor and damage type of a spell you cast (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) to another of those four elements.

name: Red Dragon Armor
effect: +1 dragoncraft full plate (+9 AC, max Dex +1, ACP -5). Grants fire resistance 15 and immunity to magical sleep and paralysis effects.

name: Red Veil
effect: One of the Seven Veils (Prismatic set). Grants continuous fire resistance 10. 1/day, produce a flame barrier blocking missiles as wind wall.

name: Reliquary Holy Symbol
effect: Functions as a holy symbol. Provides 1, 2, or 3 extra daily uses of turn/rebuke undead if you meet specific divine devotion requirements (ranks in Religion, Divine feat, etc.).

name: Repeating Crossbow of the Gunslinger
effect: A +2 speed repeating heavy crossbow (1d10, 19-20/x2). Grants an extra attack at highest base attack bonus during full attack, holding up to 5 bolts at a time.

name: Restorative Salve
effect: Contains 5 applications. Applying one dose heals 1d8+5 points of damage and immediately removes poison, disease, or blindness.

name: Revelation Crystal (Greater)
effect: Greater augment crystal (weapon, req +3 weapon). Struck target glows as faerie fire, and invisibility, etherealness, blink, and illusions are suppressed for 3 rounds.

name: Revelation Crystal (Least)
effect: Least augment crystal (weapon). Struck target glows as if by faerie fire for 1 round, shedding light and preventing concealment from darkness.

name: Revelation Crystal (Lesser)
effect: Lesser augment crystal (weapon, req +1 weapon). Struck target glows as faerie fire and any active invisibility on the target is suppressed for 1 round.

name: Rhinoceros Hide Armor
effect: +2 hide armor (+5 AC, max Dex +4, ACP -3). Whenever the wearer makes a charge attack, all damage dealt by the charge attack is doubled.

name: Ring of Adamantine Touch
effect: The wearer's melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes overcome damage reduction as if they were made of adamantine.

name: Ring of Arcane Defiance
effect: Grants spell resistance 17 against spells from the school of Evocation and Necromancy.

name: Ring of Arcane Might
effect: Grants a +1 bonus to caster level for all arcane spells cast by the wearer.

name: Ring of Armrak
effect: Contains 3 charges/day. Expend 1, 2, or 3 charges as an immediate action to absorb 1d6, 2d6, or 3d6 points of damage from an incoming attack.

name: Ring of Avoidance
effect: 3/day as an immediate action, you can gain a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against a single incoming melee or ranged attack.

name: Ring of Biofeedback
effect: Grants damage reduction 2/- to the wearer as long as you maintain psionic focus or have power points remaining in your reserve.

name: Ring of Blinking
effect: Activates the blink spell effect on command at will.

name: Ring of Bone
effect: Grants complete immunity to negative levels, ability damage, and ability drain caused by undead creatures or necromancy spells.

name: Ring of Counterspells
effect: Can store one 1st-to-6th-level spell; automatically counters that exact spell when cast at the wearer without requiring an action.

name: Ring of Dragonfriend
effect: Grants a +5 bonus on Diplomacy checks when interacting with dragons and a +4 bonus on saving throws against the frightful presence of dragons.

name: Ring of Elemental Ward
effect: Grants resistance 5 against acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic damage continuously.

name: Ring of Energy Immunity
effect: 1/day as an immediate action, gain complete immunity to one chosen energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) for 1 round.

name: Ring of Energy Partition
effect: 1/day as an immediate action when taking energy damage, gain resistance 10 against that energy type for 1 round.

name: Ring of Entropic Deflection
effect: Whenever you move at least 10 feet in a round, ranged attacks against you have a 20% miss chance until the start of your next turn (50% if running).

name: Ring of Evasion
effect: Grants the wearer the Evasion ability (taking no damage on successful Reflex saves against half-damage effects).

name: Ring of Feather Falling
effect: Activates feather fall automatically whenever wearer falls more than 5 feet.

name: Ring of Floating
effect: Prevents the wearer from sinking in water, quicksand, or other liquids. If submerged, you rise toward the surface at a rate of 30 feet per round.

name: Ring of Force Shield
effect: Generates a weightless +2 shield bonus to AC on command (force effect, no armor check penalty or arcane spell failure).

name: Ring of Fortification
effect: 1/day as an immediate action, you gain the benefits of light fortification (25% chance to negate critical hits and sneak attacks) for 1 minute.

name: Ring of Freedom of Movement
effect: Grants continuous freedom of movement as per spell: cannot be paralyzed, held, entangled, and moves freely in water.

name: Ring of Greater Counterspells
effect: Can store a single spell of up to 6th level. Automatically counters that spell without requiring an action when targeted by it.

name: Ring of Invisibility
effect: Activates invisibility (CL 3rd) on command at will.

name: Ring of Invisibility (Superior)
effect: Allows the wearer to become invisible as greater invisibility on command for up to 3 rounds per day, divided as desired.

name: Ring of Jumping
effect: Grants a +5 competence bonus on Jump checks.

name: Ring of Landwalking
effect: Grants aquatic creatures legs and feet, allowing them to walk on land with a base land speed of 30 feet.

name: Ring of Lightning Reflexes
effect: Grants a +2 enhancement bonus on Reflex saving throws (stacks with resistance bonuses from cloaks or vests).

name: Ring of Master Artifice
effect: Grants a +2 competence bonus on Craft and Use Magic Device checks, and reduces the time required to craft magical items by 25%.

name: Ring of Mind Shielding
effect: Grants complete immunity to detect thoughts, discern lies, and any attempt to magically discern alignment.

name: Ring of Mystic Defiance
effect: 3/day as an immediate action, grant yourself spell resistance 15 (or increase existing spell resistance by +2) for 1 round.

name: Ring of Mystic Fire
effect: Contains 3 charges/day. Expend charges as a swift action when casting a fire spell to deal an extra 2d6 (1 charge), 3d6 (2 charges), or 4d6 (3 charges) fire damage.

name: Ring of Mystic Healing
effect: Contains 3 charges/day. Expend charges as a swift action when casting a cure spell to restore an extra 2d6 (1 charge), 3d6 (2 charges), or 4d6 (3 charges) hit points.

name: Ring of Mystic Lightning
effect: Contains 3 charges/day. Expend charges as a swift action when casting an electricity spell to deal an extra 2d6 (1 charge), 3d6 (2 charges), or 4d6 (3 charges) electricity damage.

name: Ring of Protection (+1)
effect: Grants a +1 deflection bonus to Armor Class.

name: Ring of Protection (+2)
effect: Grants a +2 deflection bonus to Armor Class.

effect: Grants a +3 deflection bonus to Armor Class.

name: Ring of Protection (+4)
effect: Grants a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class.

name: Ring of Protection (+5)
effect: Grants a +5 deflection bonus to Armor Class.

name: Ring of Regeneration
effect: Continually heals 1 point of damage per level every hour, and regrows severed body parts and organs.

name: Ring of Resistance (+1)
effect: Grants a +1 resistance bonus on all saving throws (ring slot alternative to cloak).

name: Ring of Resistance (+2)
effect: Grants a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws (ring slot alternative to cloak).

name: Ring of Resistance (+3)
effect: Grants a +3 resistance bonus on all saving throws (ring slot alternative to cloak).

name: Ring of Resistance (+4)
effect: Grants a +4 resistance bonus on all saving throws (ring slot alternative to cloak).

name: Ring of Resistance (+5)
effect: Grants a +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (ring slot alternative to cloak).

name: Ring of Retribution
effect: 1/day as an immediate action when reduced below 0 hit points, unleash a 30-foot burst of force dealing 10d6 damage to all foes (Reflex DC 16 half).

name: Ring of Silent Spells
effect: 3/day, you can cast an arcane spell of up to 3rd level with the benefit of the Silent Spell feat without increasing the spell level or casting time.

name: Ring of Silent Stride
effect: Suppresses all sounds of your movement within 5 ft, granting a +5 competence bonus on Move Silently checks.

name: Ring of Spell Turning
effect: Can turn back up to 9 spell levels targeted directly at the wearer per day as per the spell turning spell.

name: Ring of Spell-Battle
effect: Grants a +10 competence bonus on Spellcraft checks to identify spells being cast within 60 ft. 1/day as an immediate action, counter or redirect a spell being cast within 60 ft.

name: Ring of Stalker's Guile
effect: Grants a +2 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks, and the wearer leaves no tracks or scent.

name: Ring of Sustenance
effect: Continually provides life-sustaining nourishment without food or drink. Wearer only requires 2 hours of sleep per night for a full night rest.

name: Ring of the Beast
effect: Part of the Trappings of the Beast set. A druid wearing this ring treats their effective druid level as 1 higher for animal companion abilities and wild shape duration.

name: Ring of the Darkhidden
effect: The wearer is completely invisible to darkvision (though still visible in normal light, low-light vision, and true seeing).

name: Ring of the Desert Sun
effect: Grants fire resistance 10 and immunity to dehydration. 1/day, cast daylight or flare at will.

name: Ring of the Diamond Mind
effect: Novice discipline ring. Grants the wearer access to a single Diamond Mind martial maneuver (chosen at creation) from the Tome of Battle.

name: Ring of the Eagle
effect: Grants a +2 competence bonus on Spot checks and low-light vision. 1/day as a swift action, gain see invisibility for 5 minutes.

name: Ring of the Five Virtues
effect: Part of the Five Virtues set. Grants continuous protection from evil and +2 sacred bonus on Sense Motive checks.

name: Ring of the Forest
effect: Grants the benefits of the woodland stride ability and continuous pass without trace while in natural forest environments.

name: Ring of the Forest Ward
effect: Grants continuous woodland stride and pass without trace while in natural wilderness environments.

name: Ring of the Hero
effect: Part of the Regalia of the Hero set. Grants a +2 morale bonus on melee damage rolls when fighting defensive or protecting an ally.

name: Ring of the Iron Wall
effect: Grants a +2 shield bonus to AC. 1/day as an immediate action, create an iron wall of force blocking an incoming attack.

name: Ring of the Master Tactician
effect: Part of the Master Tactician set. Grants a +2 bonus on flanking attack rolls and allows swapping initiative positions with a willing ally.

name: Ring of the Mountain
effect: Grants a +4 stability bonus against bull rush and trip attempts, and damage reduction 2/adamantine.

name: Ring of the Phoenix
effect: Part of the Regalia of the Phoenix set. 3/day, deal an extra 2d6 fire damage with any weapon strike or fire spell.

name: Ring of the Ram (Superior)
effect: Contains 50 charges. Spend 1 to 4 charges to release a spectral ram delivering up to 4d6 force damage and a bull rush attempt with a +16 Strength modifier.

name: Ring of the Sand
effect: Wearer moves across sand, dust, and gravel at full speed without penalty and leaves no tracks in sandy terrain.

name: Ring of the Sea Warden
effect: Grants water breathing, a 20 ft swim speed, and full attack actions underwater without penalty.

name: Ring of the Shadow
effect: Part of the Shadowy Diadem suite. Grants total concealment in shadowy illumination (50% miss chance instead of 20%).

name: Ring of the Shadow Walker
effect: Grants darkvision 60 ft and a +5 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks in shadows.

name: Ring of the Silver Moon
effect: Grants immunity to lycanthropy, low-light vision, and casts light at will on command.

name: Ring of the Silver Wyrm
effect: Relic of Bahamut. Grants cold immunity, feather fall at will, and 1/day project an aura of dragon fear causing foes within 60 ft to panic for 1d4 rounds (Will DC 19).

name: Ring of the Stone Sentry
effect: Grants a +2 stability bonus against bull rush and trip attempts. 1/day as a swift action, gain damage reduction 5/adamantine for 1 round.

name: Ring of the Viper
effect: Grants immunity to all poisons. 1/day on a successful melee attack, inject medium viper poison (1d6 Con / 1d6 Con, DC 14).

name: Ring of Theurgy
effect: A silver band etched with mystic runes. Can store up to three spells of up to 3rd level from a class other than your own. The wearer can cast these stored spells by expending an arcane or divine spell slot of equal level.

name: Ring of Water Breathing
effect: Grants the wearer continuous water breathing as the water breathing spell.

name: Ring of Water Striding
effect: Allows the wearer to walk on water, snow, mud, and quicksand as if on solid ground (continuous water walk).

name: Ring of Wizardry (I)
effect: Doubles the wearer's daily 1st-level arcane spell slots.

name: Ring of Wizardry (II)
effect: Doubles the wearer's daily 2nd-level arcane spell slots.

name: Ring of Wizardry (III)
effect: Doubles the wearer's daily 3rd-level arcane spell slots.

name: Ring of Wizardry (IV)
effect: Doubles the wearer's daily 4th-level arcane spell slots.

name: Ring of Wraith's Woe
effect: Part of the Wraith's Woe set. Grants a +2 deflection bonus to AC against attacks by incorporeal undead. Set bonus: full set grants ghost touch to all attacks.

name: Robe of Arcane Defense
effect: Grants a +3 armor bonus to AC and damage reduction 5/magic against all melee and ranged attacks made by creatures with spell resistance.

name: Robe of Arcane Might
effect: Grants a +4 armor bonus to AC and a +1 bonus to caster level for spells of a designated school of magic (chosen when the robe is created).

name: Robe of Blending
effect: Blends into surroundings as disguise self (+10 competence on Hide checks) and enables wearer to speak matching languages.

name: Robe of Bones
effect: Detachable skeletal patches animate into controlled Medium skeletons and zombies on command.

name: Robe of Ebonsilk
effect: Part of the Vestments of Ebonsilk set. Grants a +3 armor bonus to AC and continuous spider climb. Set bonus: grants web 3/day and shadow jump.

name: Robe of Eyes
effect: Grants 360-degree vision, darkvision 120 ft, see invisible/ethereal 120 ft, +10 Spot, +5 Search, and immunity to being flanked.

name: Robe of Mysterious Fire
effect: Grants fire resistance 10. 3/day, convert any damaging arcane spell into fire damage and increase the damage dealt by +1d6 points.

name: Robe of Power Divine
effect: Grants a +4 armor bonus to AC and a +1 bonus to caster level for all divine spells cast by the wearer. Also grants +2 sacred bonus on turning checks.

name: Robe of Retaliation
effect: Grants a +2 armor bonus to AC. 2/day as an immediate action when hit by a melee attack, unleash a blast dealing 3d6 force damage to the attacker and pushing them back 10 ft.

name: Robe of Runic Fire
effect: 3/day as a swift action, you can activate the robe to deal an extra 1d6 points of fire damage with your next fire spell, or gain fire resistance 15 for 3 rounds.

name: Robe of Runic Resonance
effect: Grants a +2 armor bonus to AC. When casting a spell with a rune, sigil, or symbol descriptor, the spell's save DC is increased by +2 and caster level is increased by +1.

name: Robe of Scintillating Colors
effect: Projects shifting rainbows of hypnotic light: dazes creatures within 30 ft and grants wearer concealment against attacks.

name: Robe of Starry Wisdom
effect: Grants a +5 competence bonus on Knowledge (arcana) checks and a +1 competence bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells. 1/day, cast true seeing for 1 minute.

name: Robe of the Archmagi
effect: Grants +5 armor bonus to AC, Spell Resistance 18, +4 resistance bonus on all saves, and +2 enhancement bonus on CL checks to overcome spell resistance.

name: Robe of the Eidolon
effect: Grants a +3 armor bonus to AC and the ability to turn ethereal (as ethereal jaunt) for up to 3 rounds per day, split as desired.

name: Robe of the Forest Guardian
effect: Grants a +3 armor bonus to AC, continuous woodland stride, and tree stride 1/day.

name: Robe of the Inferno
effect: Grants fire immunity and causes any attacker striking the wearer in melee to take 1d6+5 points of fire damage. 1/day, cast fire shield (warm).

name: Robe of the Mountain
effect: Grants a +4 armor bonus to AC, damage reduction 5/magic, and a +4 stability bonus against bull rush and trip attempts.

name: Robe of the Shining Sun
effect: Relic of Pelor. Grants a +4 armor bonus to AC, fire resistance 15, and +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against death effects and energy drain.

name: Robe of the Silver Mage
effect: Grants a +4 armor bonus to AC, +2 on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance, and +1 on save DCs of evocation spells.

name: Robe of the Vagabond
effect: Grants a +1 luck bonus on Armor Class and all saving throws. Wearer can survive without food or water as if sustained by an endure elements and sustenance effect.

name: Robe of the Winter Wolf
effect: Grants cold immunity and scent. 1/day, breathe a 15-ft cone of frost dealing 4d6 cold damage (Reflex DC 14 half).

name: Robe of Useful Items
effect: Appears as ordinary robe adorned with small cloth patches; detaching a patch transforms it into the physical item depicted.

name: Rod of Absorption
effect: Absorbs targeted spells directed at the wielder, holding up to 50 spell levels in storage. The wielder can tap the stored spell levels to cast prepared or spontaneous spells without expending spell slots.

name: Rod of Alertness
effect: Functions as a +1 light mace that grants +1 to initiative. Alerts wielder to impending danger, detects evil, chaos, law, good, or magic on command. Planted in ground, creates prayer, light, and protection auras.

name: Rod of Cancellation
effect: A single-use rod made of brittle gray stone. Touching a magic item drains all magical power from the touched item permanently (target item makes a Fortitude save to resist if attended).

name: Rod of Defiance
effect: Functions as a +2 heavy mace. All undead within 30 ft of the wielder are treated as having 4 fewer Hit Dice for the purpose of turn or rebuke undead attempts.

name: Rod of Flailing
effect: Upon command, the head separates into a +3/+3 dire flail. Once per day, the wielder can gain a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saves for 10 minutes.

name: Rod of Freedom
effect: Grants the wielder continuous freedom of movement while held. Once per day as a standard action, the wielder can cast break enchantment (CL 11th).

name: Rod of Lordly Might

name: Rod of Magical Precision
effect: While holding this slender silver rod, you can fire ranged touch spells, rays, and spell-like abilities into melee without suffering the standard -4 attack penalty.

name: Rod of Many Styles
effect: As a swift action, this rod can transform into any simple, martial, or exotic one-handed or light weapon the wielder chooses, retaining its weapon enhancement bonus and properties.

name: Rod of Negation
effect: Emits a pale gray beam that negates spells and magic item activations within 60 ft (standard action, ranged touch, 3/day). Acts as a targeted greater dispel magic with a +15 check against magic items.

name: Rod of Rulership
effect: The wielder can command the absolute loyalty and obedience of up to 500 Hit Dice of creatures within 120 ft (DC 16 Will negates) for up to 500 total minutes of cumulative use.

name: Rod of Security
effect: Transports the wielder and up to 199 other creatures to a peaceful, tranquil pocket extradimensional realm. While in paradise, visitors do not age and have all sustenance provided. Lasts up to 200 days divided by number of visitors.

name: Rod of Silence
effect: Up to 3 times per day as a standard action, creates an immobile 20-foot-radius sphere of magical silence centered on the rod for up to 5 minutes.

name: Rod of Slime
effect: Up to 3 times per day, the wielder can fling a patch of vibrant green slime at a target up to 30 ft away (ranged touch), dealing 1d6 Con damage per round to flesh or dissolving wood and metal.

name: Rod of Splendor
effect: Grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma. Once per day, creates lavish fine garments for the wielder and a magnificent silk pavilion with furnishings and banquet feast for up to 100 people.

name: Rod of Surprises
effect: Conceals 6 spring-loaded tools and small blades within its shaft: masterwork thieves' tools, a grappling hook and silk cord, a dagger, a bullseye lantern, a 10-ft pole, and a mirror.

name: Rod of the Dead

name: Rod of the Python

name: Rod of the Viper
effect: Functions as a +2 heavy mace. On command, the head becomes a living viper head that strikes on successful attacks, injecting viper poison (1d10 Con / 1d10 Con, DC 14 Fortitude save negates).

name: Rod of Trees

name: Rope of Stone

name: Ruby Blade

name: Runestaff of Fire

name: Runestaff of Frost

name: Runestaff of Illusion

name: Runestaff of Necromancy

name: Vampire Hide Armor
effect: +2 hide armor (+5 AC, max Dex +4, ACP -3). Grants damage reduction 5/silver. 1/day on a successful melee touch attack, cast vampiric touch dealing 3d6 damage and gaining temporary hp.

name: Vampire Lord Hide
effect: +3 hide armor (+6 AC, max Dex +4, ACP -3). Grants damage reduction 10/silver and magic. 2/day, cast vampiric touch dealing 4d6 damage on melee hit.

name: Vanguard Treads
effect: Wearer moves through difficult terrain (rubble, mud, undergrowth) at normal speed without penalty.

name: Vest of Arcane Ward
effect: Grants spell resistance 15 and a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws against spells.

name: Vest of Defense
effect: 3/day as an immediate action, grant yourself a +2 dodge bonus to AC against all attacks for 1 round.

name: Vest of Escape
effect: Grants a +4 competence bonus on Open Lock checks and a +10 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

name: Vest of Free Movement
effect: 3/day as a swift action, you can activate the vest to gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 3 rounds.

name: Vest of Resistance (+1)
effect: Grants a +1 resistance bonus on all saving throws (chest slot alternative to cloak).

name: Vest of Resistance (+2)
effect: Grants a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws (chest slot alternative to cloak).

name: Vest of Resistance (+3)
effect: Grants a +3 resistance bonus on all saving throws (chest slot alternative to cloak).

name: Vest of Resistance (+4)
effect: Grants a +4 resistance bonus on all saving throws (chest slot alternative to cloak).

name: Vest of Resistance (+5)
effect: Grants a +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (chest slot alternative to cloak).

name: Vest of the Archmagi
effect: Grants a +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws, +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance, and allows wearer to recall up to three 1st-4th level spells per day.

name: Vest of the Griffin
effect: Grants a +2 competence bonus on Jump checks and feather fall continuously. 1/day, make a flying charge attack with +4 on attack.

name: Vest of the Master Specialist
effect: 3/day as a swift action, cast a spell of your specialist school with an increase of +1 to the save DC and +2 to caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.

name: Vest of the Ur-Priest
effect: Grants a +2 competence bonus on Bluff and Spellcraft checks. Wearer can siphon divine magical energy to cast an extra 1st through 3rd level spell per day.

name: Vestment of Divinity
effect: Grants a +3 armor bonus to AC, +2 sacred bonus on Will saves, and enhances turn/rebuke undead checks by +2.

name: Vestment of Many Styles
effect: On command, transforms instantly into any normal set of clothing or garb imaginable.

name: Vestment of the Holy
effect: Grants a +2 sacred bonus on Armor Class and allows the wearer to channel healing spells to cure +1 hp per die rolled.

name: Vestment of the Sea
effect: Grants continuous water breathing and freedom of movement while underwater.

name: Vestment of the Sun Father
effect: Grants a +4 sacred bonus to AC and enhances all turning checks by +2. 1/day, cast daylight at will.

name: Vestment of the Vermin
effect: Grants immunity to natural insect and vermin bites, poison, and diseases. 1/day, summon a swarm of centipedes as summon swarm.

name: Vestments of the Blessed Healer
effect: Relic of Pelor. Whenever you cast a conjuration (healing) spell, it restores +2 hp per spell level, and 1/day, apply the Empower Spell feat to a healing spell without slot cost.

name: Violet Veil
effect: One of the Seven Veils (Prismatic set). Grants spell resistance 17. Set synergy: wearing all seven veils grants prismatic spray 1/day.

name: Wand Bracelet
effect: Contains four small clasps holding wands, rods, or light weapons (up to 3 lbs each). As a swift action, you can call any clasped item into your hand, returning any held item back to the bracelet.

name: War Fan of the Geisha
effect: A +2 steel war fan (1d6, crit x3). Grants a +4 competence bonus on Bluff checks to feint in combat and can be drawn or concealed with Sleight of Hand as a free action.

name: War Wizard Cloak (Head function)
effect: Secondary function of the War Wizard Cloak when configured for the head slot: grants darkvision 60 ft and feather fall on command.

name: Warhammer of the Iron King
effect: A +2 impact warhammer (1d8, 19-20/x3). On a successful critical hit, forces the target to make a DC 16 Fortitude save or be knocked prone and dazed for 1 round.

name: Warlock's Mail
effect: +1 studded leather (+4 AC, 0% arcane spell failure). Grants a +1 bonus on ranged touch attack rolls with eldritch blast and +1d6 eldritch blast damage.

name: Warlock's Mail (Greater)
effect: +3 studded leather (+6 AC, 0% arcane spell failure). Grants a +2 bonus on ranged touch attacks with eldritch blast and +2d6 eldritch blast damage.

name: Warning Horn
effect: Blowing this horn warns all allies within 1 mile of approaching danger, granting them a +2 morale bonus on initiative checks and saves vs surprise for 1 hour.

name: Well of Many Worlds
effect: A 6-foot circular black cloth that appears as a dark hole when unfolded on a surface. Stepping through travels directly to a random plane or alternate dimension. Folding the cloth takes 1 round.

name: Whip of the Webspinner
effect: A +2 web whip (1d4 nonlethal, crit x2, 15 ft reach). Deals lethal damage to armored targets. On hit, wielder can initiate a grapple or entangle the target as if by a web spell (DC 15).

name: Wind Fan
effect: A folding wood fan painted with cloud motifs. Fanning creates a gust of wind as a standard action. Can be used at will, but each activation beyond the first in a day carries a 20% cumulative risk of tearing the fan.

name: Winged Boots
effect: Allows wearer to fly as per the fly spell (speed 60 ft, good maneuverability) up to 3 times per day for up to 2 hours per use.

name: Wings of Flying
effect: Transforms cloak into bat or bird wings granting a fly speed of 60 ft with good maneuverability.

name: Wings of the Dragon
effect: When activated as a standard action, sprouts draconic wings granting a fly speed of 60 ft (good maneuverability) for up to 1 hour per day, split into 10-minute increments.

name: Witchgreen Crystal (Greater)
effect: Greater augment crystal (weapon, req +3 weapon). A creature struck takes a -5 penalty on Concentration checks and must make a DC 16 Fortitude save or lose the ability to cast spells or manifest powers for 1 round.

name: Witchgreen Crystal (Least)
effect: Least augment crystal (weapon). A creature struck takes a -2 penalty on Concentration checks for 1 round.

name: Witchgreen Crystal (Lesser)
effect: Lesser augment crystal (weapon, req +1 weapon). A creature struck takes a -5 penalty on Concentration checks and a -2 penalty on caster level checks for 1 round.

name: Yellow Veil
effect: One of the Seven Veils (Prismatic set). Grants electricity resistance 10. 1/day, discharge a blinding ray (Fort DC 15 or blind 1 round).

name: Zombie Hide Armor
effect: +1 hide armor (+4 AC, max Dex +4, ACP -3). Grants damage reduction 5/slashing to the wearer.
